purpose: Design proposal for confirmation; illustrative content; not an app screenshot.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a finished high fidelity desktop application design proposal for Lune, a Chinese collaborative music listening app. Landscape 16:10, crisp legible Chinese typography, edge-to-edge actual app UI, no device or browser frame, no annotations. The attached existing app screenshot is a STYLE REFERENCE only: inherit near-black surfaces, ivory Chinese sans serif text, fine separators, restrained lavender accents and uninterrupted bottom player. Replace the narrow library with a spacious unified full music workspace.

Screen: playlist DETAIL. Left navigation rail: Lune / 一起听, 正在播放, 搜索音乐, 发现歌单 selected, 共听热榜, 我的音乐; room group 播放队列 12, 房间成员 3. Only one 设置 at bottom, room status 3 人在房间 and 邀请码 206418. Main top is a discreet breadcrumb 发现歌单 / 夜色慢慢落下. This is the ONLY local return route. Under it, an editorial but compact header: clearly bounded square coastal dusk photographic playlist cover on left, entirely separate text column on right. Title 夜色慢慢落下, metadata 微光收集者 · 24 首 · 网易云音乐, one quiet sentence 适合和朋友一起听的深夜旋律。 One lavender primary button “全部加入队列” beneath metadata. No other hero buttons, no giant decorative banner.

Below: flat music table with a subtle 1px separator and consistent columns 序号, 歌曲, 专辑, 时长, row actions. Seven realistic rows: 私生活 / 東京事変 / Hard Disk / 3:49; Goodbye / toe / For Long Tomorrow / 7:34; Lady / chilldspot / ingredients / 3:37; Your Love / Cradle Orchestra / Velvet Ballads / 5:21; 银河 / 轻声 / 夜航 / 4:12; 海岸线 / 月下 / 远方来信 / 3:58; 慢慢 / 南风 / 夜色 / 4:06. Song and artist as two clean lines, small square artwork in its own column cell, album and duration aligned. Reserve narrow right edge for understated bookmark and plus outline icons, only the hovered third row reveals these actions, no filled button on every row, no 查看. Plenty of readable rows fit.

Bottom persistent player: small cover, 私生活 / 東京事変, sync dot and 3 人一起听, progress 1:28 / 3:49, heart, volume, lavender 下一首. No pause button. No upper return button, no mode switch, no duplicated title bar or source controls. No overlapping text, nested cards, glow, gradients or excessive borders. Small subtle label 设计稿 · 内容为示例.
